adminLimits.howMuchPeopleCanCreateOn: How much people can create on this instance. Lowering a limit keeps what already exists; it only stops new ones past it.

adminLimits.theyKeepThemButCanT: They keep them, but can't create more until they're under the limit.
adminLimits.howManyProjectsAnyOneOrganization: How many projects any one organization can have. Its Owners and Administrators can set a lower limit for it.
adminLimits.itKeepsThemButCanT: It keeps them, but can't add more until it's under the limit.

adminNotice.aMessageForEveryoneSignedIn: A message for everyone signed in, such as planned downtime.
adminNotice.noticePostedEveryoneSignedInSees: Notice posted; everyone signed in sees it within a minute
adminNotice.theNoticeAsEveryoneWillSee: The notice as everyone will see it, as you edit.
adminNotice.writeAMessageToSeeThe: Write a message to see the notice.

adminNotice.supermixerWillBeDownForAn: Supermixer will be down for an upgrade on Saturday, 22:00–23:00 UTC.

adminOrganizations.everyOrganizationOnThisInstanceFor: Every organization on this instance, for reports. Listing an organization doesn't give you access to it: that stays with its members.
adminOrganizations.isNoLongerSetUpOn: {{ssoProvider}} is no longer set up on this instance, so it isn’t enforced

adminProjects.everyProjectOnThisInstanceFor: Every project on this instance, for reports. Listing a project doesn't give you access to it: that stays with its organization's members.

adminSignUp.eachInstanceAdminWithAnEmail: Each instance admin with an email address gets an email when someone signs up.
